We started with a tree, now we have a table! After a giant mango fell, Roberto spent 3 days milling barefoot with a chainsaw then we dried it for 4 months before starting to work it today. 

We picked out a groovy cross cut for the table & curved branch sections for the bench seats then Kobi & Charli spent hours sanding them down smooth.

It’s gonna take some time to finish this live edge but it should last long enough for the the kid’s kids to eat dinner at it too 🇨🇷🪵👷🏼‍♂️ #joefelz #costarica #woodworking #raisethemright

caption.text: My 1280 lbs of solar supplies have made it to Costa & officially cleared customs. It might not look like much but this one photo represents 6 months of work figuring out the import process & several trips to the @bigbatteryinc factory to test the equipment before it shipped internationally. Now just gotta figure out building the solar roof and Farday cage . THE ENDLESS WORK CONTINUES 🇨🇷☀️🔋 #joefelz #solar #offgrid #renewableenergy #international

Who else thinks it’s stupid to install a metal roof then cover it with waterproof solar panels? I certainly do, so I’m planning to build this entire roof out of solar panels. 
I plan on leaving the wiring exposed at the bottom so during classes people can see the electrical phenomenon of series verse parallel wiring. 
I’ve never done this before, so wish me luck! 🇨🇷☀️🔋 #joefelz #buildingreality #solar #construction #electricianlife
